stem: Two lighting schedules produce the same calculated DLI, but one uses a higher PPFD for fewer hours. Which statement is most scientifically cautious?
choices: Equal DLI guarantees identical plant responses
Equal DLI means the daily photon dose is similar, but intensity and photoperiod differences can still matter biologically
The schedule with higher PPFD is always superior
Photoperiod is irrelevant once DLI is matched
rationale: DLI summarizes daily photon dose, but plants can respond to instantaneous intensity and photoperiod as well. Equivalent DLI should not be assumed to guarantee identical biological outcomes.
